content.summary: ECD Automotive Design (ECDA) “announced that it will implement a 1-for-5 reverse stock split of its issued and outstanding common stock, effective at market opening time on December 26, 2025. ECD common stock will remain on the Nasdaq Capital Market and begin trading on a split-adjusted basis when the markets open on December 26, 2025.
